quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo press release: Notice Regarding the Completion of a New Manufacturing (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TOK completed construction (October 8, 2026) of a new semiconductor-photoresist manufacturing building at its Koriyama Plant (Fukushima Prefecture), which makes EUV and ArF photoresists among others and which the company calls one of the world's largest facilities of its kind; construction began in July 2024 and operations are scheduled to start in November 2026, to raise quality and expand supply capacity with automated, digitalized lines. Building area 4,800 m2, investment approximately JPY 23 billion; the impact is already reflected in the consolidated forecast announced August 6, 2026, and the group says it will keep considering proactive capital investment to expand production.
quarterly_data.figure: investment approximately JPY 23 billion; building area 4,800 m2; operations from November 2026
